data.description:
## Incident Overview

During /dso:debug-everything (61b8 integration), the pre-commit `Test Isolation Check` (hook id: isolation-check, check-test-isolation.sh) was killed at its 60s budget (exit 124) on a commit staging a large test file.

**code_version:** fc99b752c4

### Repro / Evidence
- Staged file: tests/scripts/test_ticket_graph.py (2528 lines).
- Run manually with STAGED_ONLY=true and a 200s timeout: exit=0 (PASS) but **elapsed 63s** — 3s over the 60s pre-commit budget.
- Pre-commit therefore fails with TIMEOUT (exit 124) even though the check passes given ~3 more seconds.

### Expected
The isolation check completes within budget for normal-sized staged test files, OR the budget accommodates large files. The check itself reports no blocking violation (only advisory no-direct-os-environ notes; exit 0).

### Impact
Blocks legitimate commits that stage large test files. Same class as bc03 (hook budget exceeded under load).

### Likely fix direction
Profile check-test-isolation.sh rule loop (per-line/per-rule subprocess cost on large files); either optimize the rule scan or raise/relax the 60s budget for the isolation hook. SAFEGUARD FILE — requires user approval to modify.
data.title: [check-test-isolation.sh]: 60s pre-commit budget exceeded (~63s) on large staged test file -> commit blocked by TIMEOUT exit 124
